description: Log a play of a pinball game for the authenticated user. Use get_game_details first if you only have a slug — this tool needs the id from that response. playedAt must be today or earlier; at most 20 plays per game per day are accepted. Set dateKnown=false when the user has played the game but doesn't remember when or where; the diary will render "at some point". Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

dateKnown.description: Defaults to true. Set to false when the play is a vague 'I played this at some point' claim with no real date.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

isReplay.description: Flag as a replay rather than first-time play

locationText.description: Freeform location name if locationId is unknown

playedAt.description: Play date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or earlier. Still required when dateKnown is false — send today's date as a placeholder.

score.description: Score on the machine, not a fun rating

name: kineticist_log_play
title: Log a play
